system.description:
The Aldorethi art of illusion out of the Silver Tower and the school of Eccria: scholarship and precision disguised as entertainment.

  • Precise Focus: you may concentrate on two Illusion spells at once; a failed concentration save ends both.
    • 9th level: Advantage on those saves.
  • Tower Insight: Advantage on checks to identify, detect or dispel another caster's illusions.
